maddeler.e:
نتناسل (form VI)
# نَتَنَاسَلُ (natanāsalu) /na.ta.naː.sa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاسَلَ (tanāsala)
# نَتَنَاسَلَ (natanāsala) /na.ta.naː.sa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاسَلَ (tanāsala)
# نَتَنَاسَلْ (natanāsal) /na.ta.naː.sal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاسَلَ (tanāsala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
